name: Helmsman Pike

intro.text: Pager's quiet, so I'm free for a scrap. Volunteer crew, all of us. If the pager goes, I'm gone mid-sentence, and you'll know the reason.

win: Well done. If you ever get into trouble out there, you'll know who to call.
after: Over a hundred thousand people have been saved by RNLI crews since 1824. I'm proud to be a small bit of that.
